content.title: Chapter 22 - BUSINESSES — Sec. 22-54. - Application fee.
content.summary:
Each applicant, whether an individual, partnership, corporation, or other legal entity,
               shall pay an application fee of $150.00 at the time of filing an application. Such
               application fee shall be nonrefundable.
